title: The Courtship of Susan Bell
author: Anthony Trollope
description: "The Courtship of Susan Bell" by Anthony Trollope is a novel written in the mid-19th century, likely reflecting themes and societal norms of the Victorian era.
longDescription: The story centers around the life of Susan Bell and her family, particularly focusing on the romantic developments between Susan and her lodger, Aaron Dunn.

authorInfo.bio: Anthony Trollope (1815–1882) is the author of The Warden. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
